articles.title: Trump’s Gaza plan under fire as Israel restricts flood aid
articles.description: More than a year after President Donald Trump announced a ceasefire to end the war in Gaza, Israel continues to restrict the delivery of shelter materials and rubble-clearing machinery.

articles.title: Israel Could Send Humanoid Robots Into Gaza's Tunnels Amid Talks With Firm Backed by Eric Trump
articles.description: The robots are capable of engaging in combat, neutralizing explosive devices and detecting trip wires.

articles.title: Israeli strike on Gaza hospital kills six, including surgeon, medics say
articles.description: By Nidal al-MughrabiCAIRO, Nov 12 (Reuters) - An Israeli airstrike on southern Gaza's main hospital overnight killed at least six Palestinians including a surgeon and a teenage boy, medics said, the latest Israeli attack to undermine a year-old ceasefire in the war-shattered territory. The strike hit a building containing surgery wards at Nasser Hospital in Khan Younis. Israel's military said it targeted a senior Hamas commander and accused the militants of using the hospital complex to plan attacks, which the group denied.

articles.title: Lewis Hamilton: Ferrari's seven-time F1 world champion urges Israel to 'let the aid trucks in' to Gaza after visit to Rafah border
articles.description: Lewis Hamilton visited the Rafah border on Tuesday to witness efforts to transport aid into Gaza; Ferrari driver published Instagram post on Wednesday calling on Israel to fulfil its obligations under the ceasefire

articles.title: Netanyahu says Israel is not to blame for the flood crisis in Gaza, and other Mideast news
articles.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu dismisses claims — including from the U.S.-backed Board of Peace — that Israel is blocking winter supplies to Gaza. Severe rains have flooded makeshift tents, worsening conditions in the enclave. Netanyahu blames Hamas for the suffering, accusing them of seizing aid for military use. British Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband and U.S. Senator Brian Schatz demand Israel allow aid into Gaza. Meanwhile, Iran reports a tanker caught fire after hitting a naval mine in the Strait of Hormuz. The British military also reports an incident with a tanker there. In Gaza, Israeli strikes killed three people, as tensions continue despite a ceasefire.
